Pantry Inventory

Track pantry items with quantities and expiry dates; items expiring soon are highlighted.

Inventory

🟡 = expires within 7 days   🔴 = expired

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the item name, quantity and unit.
  2. Pick an expiry date (or leave blank for non-perishables).
  3. Click Add Item — soon-to-expire items are highlighted automatically.
  4. Use + / − to adjust quantities, or delete finished items.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I add a pantry item?

Enter the item name, quantity, unit, and expiry date, then click Add Item.

What does the expiring-soon highlight mean?

Items expiring within 7 days get a yellow highlight; expired items get a red one.

How do I update quantities?

Use the + / − buttons on each row to adjust the quantity without retyping it.

Where is my inventory stored?

In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.
